name: first_open
label: Open the first panel by default

default.title: Do I need a developer to build a page?
default.content: No. Every module in this theme is drag-and-drop in the HubSpot page editor. Fields are plain text, rich text, images and links.

default.title: How do we change the brand colours?
default.content: Under Design > Theme settings. The values flow into one stylesheet; every module picks them up automatically.

default.title: What happens without JavaScript?
default.content: Everything stays readable. Accordion panels render expanded and tabs render as a stacked list of sections.
